verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on controlling a settlement or payout schedule, and nothing on a per-payout breakdown of the charges, fees, and refunds in each settlement. The only nearby items don't qualify. Like-for-like settlement into the Airwallex Wallet is about settlement currency, not schedule or line-item reconciliation. Transfers are outbound payments to suppliers and employees, a different capability. The refunds docs cover issuing refunds, not reconciling them against payouts. AgentOS cashflow reports are an adjacent feature.
